title: @prisma/adapter-pg ignores ?schema= in the connection URL and queries the public schema
symptoms: The table `public.Item` does not exist in the current database.
prisma db push created the tables in the schema named in the URL, but the client looks in public
Raw queries fail with 42P01 relation does not exist
cause: The Prisma CLI honors the schema URL parameter, but the pg driver adapter takes the schema only from its own options and falls back to public.
fix: Pass schema in the adapter options for model queries, and set search_path through the connection string options parameter so raw queries resolve too. Check that your pooler forwards startup options before relying on search_path through it.
affected: prisma-client generator with @prisma/adapter-pg from Prisma 6.15, still open at 7.4 per the issue and reproduced on 7.10.0 on 2026-10-15; open bug, re-check before relying on this trap
